app.tagline: Know what will be left on your account at the end of every month.
login.title: Log in
login_code.title: Verification code
login_code.intro: Open your authenticator app and type the 6-digit code for Budget Cockpit.
login_code.recovery_hint: No access to your phone? Type one of your recovery codes instead.
setup.title: First start
setup.intro: Create the administrator account. There is no default password. You can then create other accounts, each with its own budget.
setup.demo: Start with sample data (you can change it afterwards)
freq.yearly_table: Annual amount per year, spread over 12 months
freq.monthly_help: The same amount every month (rent, loan, subscription…).
freq.yearly_help: One amount once a year, in the chosen month (tax, bonus…).
freq.profile_help: One amount for each month of the year, repeated every year (seasonal rental, electricity…).
freq.manual_help: Nothing by default: type the amount directly in the month you want (on-call pay, one-off income…).
freq.yearly_table_help: An annual amount per year, set aside in twelfths (tax provision…). The last year given carries on to the following years.
budget.card_balance_sub: What will remain on your current account
budget.hint: Click a cell to change that month's amount; an empty cell goes back to the rule. In the current month, ✓ marks an expense as paid or income as received: it is already in your balance, so it no longer counts.
budget.state_rule: Amount computed from the line's rule
budget.state_paid: Already paid or received: included in your current balance
budget.savings_total_help: Your current savings (Settings) plus the planned transfers: updates as soon as you change an amount.
lines.intro: Each line has a rule: every month, once a year, an amount per month… The budget is computed from these rules.
lines.confirm_delete: Delete the line “{name}” and the amounts typed for it?
rule.profile: Depends on the month ({total} per year)
rule.yearly_table: Annual amount per year ({n} year(s) defined)
line.name: Name
line.group_help: To follow a set of lines on its own, e.g. a rental property: its income minus its expenses.
line.yearly_table_help: One year per line, for example “2027 = 1200”.
line.active: Active line (untick to pause it without deleting it)
close.title: Close {month}
close.intro: Do this at the start of the next month: the past month disappears, along with its typed amounts, and your real balance becomes the new starting point.
close.balance_help: Prefilled with the forecast. Replace it with your real balance.
close.confirm: Close {month}? This month will disappear from the budget.
settings.current_balance_help: Update it when you check your accounts, and tick ✓ what has already gone through this month.
settings.threshold_help: Below it, the alert shows “Warning”. Below 0, “Overdraft”.
api.title: Home Assistant and API
api.intro: A key lets Home Assistant read your forecast balance and overdraft alert (read only). See the documentation to set up the sensors.
api.new_token_help: Copy it now: it will never be shown again. Only its fingerprint is stored.
api.name: Name
api.confirm_revoke: Revoke this key? Home Assistant will no longer be able to read your data with it.
backup.title: Backup
backup.intro: Export everything (settings, lines, typed amounts) to a JSON file. Importing replaces everything.
backup.confirm_import: Import this file? All your current lines and settings will be replaced.
password.title: Password
account.password_intro: Welcome {name}! An administrator created your account or reset your password. Now choose your own password: only you will know it.
admin.title: Administration
admin.intro: Each account has its own budget, in its own database. Here you manage the accounts: you do not see their budgets.
admin.confirm_intro: The administration pages will then stay open for {minutes} minutes.
admin.new_user_help: Pick a temporary password and give it to the person: they will have to replace it with their own at their first login.
admin.demo: Fill their budget with the demo data
admin.self_note: This is your account: your password and two-factor authentication are managed in
admin.reset_help: For a forgotten password. The person is logged out everywhere and will choose a new password at their next login.
admin.totp_help: For a lost phone without recovery codes. The password alone will be enough again, and the person can turn it back on in their settings.
admin.role_help: An administrator can create, change and delete accounts, but does not see their budgets.
admin.delete_help: The account, its budget, API keys and two-factor authentication are erased for good. Ask them to export their budget first.
admin.delete_confirm: Delete the account {name} and its budget for good?
mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.intro: On top of your password, Budget Cockpit will ask for a 6-digit code shown by an app on your phone. Someone who found out your password could not log in without that phone.
mfa.scan_help: In your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis, 2FAS, Bitwarden…), add an account and scan this QR code.
mfa.qr_alt: QR code to scan with your authenticator app
mfa.manual: Can't scan it? Type the key instead
mfa.manual_help: Type: time-based (TOTP), 6 digits, new code every 30 seconds.
mfa.enabled_now: Two-factor authentication is on. Other browsers have been logged out.
mfa.codes_once: Write these codes down now: they will never be shown again.
mfa.codes_help: If you lose your phone, type one of these codes instead of the 6-digit code. Each code works once. Keep them in your password manager or print them, but not on that same phone.
mfa.manage_help: To get new recovery codes (the old ones stop working) or turn two-factor authentication off, confirm with your password and a code.
mfa.confirm_disable: Turn off two-factor authentication? The password alone will be enough to log in again.
summary.intro: Each year, computed over the months shown in the budget.
chart.balance_title: Your current account, end of month
chart.balance_aria: Left at end of month from {start} to {end}. Lowest: {low} in {month}.
chart.room_shortfall: To never go under your {threshold} threshold, you are {amount} short, to be found by {month}: a withdrawal from savings, one transfer less or a postponed expense.
chart.room_intro: On top of the transfers already planned, you can put aside without going under your {threshold} threshold:
chart.room_none: No room to put more aside over the next 12 months without going under your {threshold} threshold.
chart.flow_title: What each month adds to or takes from your account
chart.flow_help: Income minus expenses and transfers to savings. Above zero, the month fills your current account; below, it drains it.
chart.flow_aria: Balance of each month, from {start} to {end}.
chart.savings_help: Your savings today, plus the transfers and minus the withdrawals typed on your savings lines.
chart.group_title: {group}: month result and year to date
chart.group_help: Income minus expenses of this group's lines. The running total starts again from zero every January.
chart.group_aria: {group}: result of each month and year to date, from {start} to {end}.
summary.footnote: Real saving capacity = planned savings + unallocated: what you can put aside over the year.
flash.welcome: Welcome! Enter your current balance, then add your lines under “Lines”.
flash.password_changed: Password changed. Other browsers have been logged out.
flash.user_created: Account “{name}” created. Give them their temporary password.
flash.user_password_reset: {name}'s password has been reset. Give them the temporary password.
flash.recovery_used: Logged in with a recovery code. {n} left: get new ones in Settings if needed.
error.title: Oops
error.csrf: The form has expired. Reload the page and try again.
error.name: A name is required
error.profile: An amount is needed for each of the 12 months
error.yearly_table: Give at least one year, for example “2027 = 1200”
error.end_before_start: The end date is before the start date
error.horizon: The number of months must be between 1 and 120
error.import_format: This file is not a valid Budget Cockpit backup
error.password_same: Choose a password different from the temporary one
error.confirm_username: The name typed does not match: nothing was deleted.
error.password_mismatch: The two passwords do not match
error.locked: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error.code_setup: Wrong code. Check that your phone's clock is right and type the code shown now.
error.code_expired: Too slow. Log in again with your password.
budget.balance_hint: Then tick ✓ what has already gone through this month.
